feeds.title: Lady Engineering Blog
feeds.description: Software Engineer, Latina, writer & yogi turned career and personal growth advisor. Lady Engineering was created to share my lifestyle, experience and learnings being a minority in tech. I'm here to motivate women to break barriers and follow their dreams by cultivating a happy, balanced, goal-oriented life.

feeds.title: Geeky Girl Engineer
feeds.description: I am a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, Master of Engineering in Civil Engineering, and a Doctor of Philosophy in Environmental Science and Engineering. I write about nature, travel, pets, home renovation, and geekery along with bits about my work in engineering field.

feeds.title: The Engineering Experience Blog
feeds.description: Explore what life is like as a Purdue engineering student from the stories, thoughts, and perspectives of current Purdue Boilermakers. We're here to connect you to Purdue and answer any questions you have about Purdue Women in Engineering. As current undergraduate women in engineering, we are your link to engineering, student life, and everything Purdue has to offer! We are dedicated to smoothing your transition into engineering and life at Purdue by answering your questions and sharing our knowledge with you.

feeds.title: Women Research Engineering Network Blog
feeds.description: Read women's success stories across the world and the latest news on how the WREN and its partners are supporting women advance in their careers. The Women's Research Engineers Network is established to support women in engineering, with a vision for equity in the engineering research community from early to mid and senior academic levels. The WREN provides a channel to promote international collaboration between women research engineers and increase the awareness of leaders to implement policies that support women in their academic careers.

feeds.title: The Female Engineer Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emilie, a twenty-something mechanical engineer, STEM advocate, avid adventurer and maker. I am here to give you an insight into the life of an engineer, whilst challenging misconceptions and hopefully inspiring you to chase your dreams and live your best life! All of this with a sprinkling of rock music, craft beer and motorcycles.

feeds.title: women engineers' history
feeds.description: Explore histories of Women Working in Engineering and Construction in the UK. I am a former merchant navy deck officer who later became a materials engineer and then a politician. Now I am a historian specialising in the history of women in the history of UK engineering and construction trades and professions.
